GRAIN
YOUR GRAIN, OUR PRIORITY
At Agwrx, we earn your grain business every day through reliable delivery, storage, and marketing solutions you can count on. Our network of facilities provides 21.7 million bushels of storage capacity, supported by ongoing investments in modern elevators and high-efficiency grain drying systems.
With over 50,000 bushels per hour of dumping capacity, we help reduce wait times during the busiest harvest days. Select locations feature automated grain receiving that scans your grain and initiates your ticket upon arrival, speeding up the unloading process. Grain drying is available at all Agwrx facilities to help protect crop quality and maximize value.
COMPETITIVE BIDS & EXPERT MARKETING
Agwrx offers competitive daily bids on wheat, oats, corn, and soybeans. You’ll work directly with an experienced merchandiser to develop a customized grain marketing and contracting strategy designed to meet your operation’s profit goals.
Choose Agwrx for dependable grain handling, strong market bids, and expert support - from delivery through final sale.
